concept.title: Matching on words does not work
concept.shortdesc: An earlier attempt with keyword rules could not tell a service from a page that merely mentions it.

conbody.p: An earlier attempt used 63 keyword rules. It had three weaknesses.

ul.li: It could not tell “we run yoga classes” from “find a yoga class near you”, because both contain the word “yoga”.
Rules tuned on one council's writing style did worse on another's.
About one listing in seven matched no rule at all.
